{{Top|leg}}
The '''Sebiri language''' was the native tongue of the [[Sebiri]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was mainly composed of grunts and multi-sylabbic staccato phrases, coupled with a hand gestures that made up the majority of their speech. As a result, the Sebiri were able to communicate silently with ease. Two words in the Sebiri language were "[[K'va't'uuk]]," meaning "gifts," and "[[L'ttuuk'chk]]," meaning "holy ground" or "forbidden land."
